# ANALYSIS: STAGE1_BACKTEST_VERIFY_J_ANCHORS

**Filed:** 2026-07-13  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** analysis  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The current production engine (BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON + VWAP_CONTINUATION + GAP_AND_GO) generates P&L on the three J winner days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) that is within ±20% of the BS-simulated P&L when using realistic OPRA fills and a walk-forward held-out window. This validates simulator fidelity before further optimization.

## Mechanism

Run a Stage-1 backtest over the full 16-month history (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) with a walk-forward held-out window (80% in-sample, 20% out-of-sample, chronological split). For each of the three J winner days, compute:
- BS-sim P&L (using the internal Black‑Scholes simulator with current params)
- Real‑fills P&L (using cached OPRA bid/ask, slippage model, and the same entry/exit logic)
Calculate the percent difference (real‑fills – BS‑sim) / BS‑sim. Pass if |diff| ≤ 0.20 for all three days. Additionally, record edge_capture and aggregate Sharpe for the OOS window to ensure no hidden degradation.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper ≈ 14% headline P&L (per OP-20).  
2. **Sample bias:** analysis uses only the three J winner days (n=3) for the ±20% check; small sample size increases variance and overfit risk. The walk‑forward OOS window uses ~20% of the 16‑month series (≈3.2 months) to mitigate bias.  
3. **Out-of-sample:** walk‑forward held‑out window (20% OOS) will be reported; if not yet computed, status is NEEDS-OOS.  
4. **Real-fills:** will compare BS‑sim vs cached OPRA real‑fills on the three anchor days; if not yet done, status is NEEDS-REAL-FILLS.  
5. **Failure modes:** worst day (max single‑day loss), max drawdown over OOS window, blow‑up scenario (e.g., consecutive losses exceeding daily risk cap).  
6. **Concentration:** will report top‑5 days % of total P&L for the OOS window; if top‑5 days > 50% we will flag concentration risk.

## Pre-merge gate

- Gym validators (`test_*_stage1.py`) must pass.  
- Walk‑forward OOS edge_capture ≥ 0 (no negative edge).  
- Real‑fills verification on 4/29, 5/01, 5/04 within ±20% of BS‑sim.  
- No regression on J loser days (engine must not turn losers into winners beyond allowed loss).  
- OOS Sharpe ≥ 0.5 (minimum acceptable).

## Confidence

5 / 10 -- based on prior observation that BS‑sim tends to over‑estimate ITM‑0DTE premium (see L23) but the three anchor days are high‑vol, high‑liquidity events where the bias may be smaller. The walk‑forward OOS window will reveal any regime‑dependent drift.

## Pre-existing leaderboard impact

This analysis does not modify any strategy parameter or rule; it is a validation step. It therefore does not conflict with existing candidates in _LEADERBOARD.md. If the verification passes, it increases confidence in the current engine and may support future candidates that rely on accurate simulation. If it fails, it would trigger a re‑calibration of the simulation layer before any further optimization.
